title: TD-H9 APRS Smart Beaconing
description: Reverse engineering of the TIDRADIO TD-H9 handheld radio (JieLi AC695X SoC and ARM APRS module) to add GNSS-driven APRS smart beaconing. Contains the project write-up, architecture, method and a portable C99 beacon scheduler and NMEA RMC parser with tests. Vendor firmware, patch offsets and flashable images are intentionally not included. Code: MIT. Documentation: CC BY 4.0.
